title: ZamorinProductionReleaseChecklist
description: Pre-flight and post-deployment release verification gates for Zamorin Café ERP

preFlightGates.name: Automated Quality & Regression Test Suites Pass
preFlightGates.requirement: npm run test:deploy-readiness exits code 0 with P0=0, P1=0

preFlightGates.name: Environment & Production Secret Validation
preFlightGates.requirement: Universal startup configuration validator reports zero MISSING or UNSAFE critical variables

preFlightGates.name: Database Migration Safety Pre-Flight
preFlightGates.requirement: migration_safety_checker.mjs confirms all pending migrations are backward-compatible

preFlightGates.name: MongoDB Atlas Backup Verification
preFlightGates.requirement: Latest automated cluster snapshot verified and restore capability confirmed

preFlightGates.name: Render Persistent Document Storage Verification
preFlightGates.requirement: Disk root mounted at /var/data/zamorin_documents with free capacity > 15%

preFlightGates.name: Release Manifest Generation
preFlightGates.requirement: LATEST_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json generated with git commit SHA and rollback target

postDeployGates.name: Critical User Journey Smoke Test
postDeployGates.requirement: Read-only auth login context and POS catalog resolve with zero errors

postDeployGates.name: Post-Deploy Observation Window
postDeployGates.requirement: Zero SEV-1 alerts and 500 error rate < 0.05% for initial 30 minutes
